relay.usage_reset.confirm_prompt: {count, plural, one {Uses your last reset credit; clears this account’s rate-limit windows.} other {Uses 1 of # reset credits; clears this account’s rate-limit windows.}}
relay.usage_reset.outcome_reset: {count, plural, =0 {Reset applied.} one {Reset applied — 1 window cleared.} other {Reset applied — # windows cleared.}}
relay.usage_reset.outcome_already_redeem: This reset had already been applied.
relay.usage_reset.outcome_nothing_to_res: Nothing was over its limit, so no window needed clearing.
relay.usage_reset.outcome_failed: Couldn’t confirm the reset. Try again to check — a retry will not use a second credit.
relay.usage_reset.refused: Nothing was spent — the reset was refused. Refresh the list.
